engage_descriptions.3060-3092-spring-street-and-80-85-electr:
Thank you to everyone who provided feedback on this development application. The public input period has concluded.
Application #ORD00008
Location: 3060-3088 Spring Street, 80-85 Electronic Avenue, and a portion of the Electronic Avenue road right-of-way
Developer website:
https://springst.beedie.ca/
We would like your feedback on an OCP amendment, rezoning and development permit application at 3060-3088 Spring Street, 80-85 Electronic Avenue, and a portion of the Electronic Avenue road right-of-way. The applicant would like to amend the Official Community Plan from 26 to 32, 34, and 38 storeys and rezone the site from Light Industrial (M1) to a new Comprehensive Development (CD) zoning to allow for three towers—32, 34, and 38 storeys—above a commercial podium, adjacent to the Moody Central Transit Station.
This proposal includes:
Approximately 983 residential units in market condos/strata homes, divided into three residential towers as follows:
West Tower: 34 storeys
Mid Tower: 38 storeys
East Tower: 32 storeys
A maximum of 80,080m
2
(861, 974ft
2
) of residential floor space;
A minimum of 6,300m
2
(67,813ft
2
) commercial floor space;
A minimum of 1,975m
2
(21,259ft
2
) common amenity space;
A minimum of 868 parking spaces (687 residential spaces and 181 commercial and visitor spaces)
The applicant is proposing to provide approximately 40-60 below-market units at a separate site located at
2806 Spring Street.
Next Steps
On November 25, 2025, City Council adopted the OCP Amendment Bylaw and Zoning Amendment Bylaw, and endorsed the associated Development Agreement. The proposal is now approved to move forward with the next phase of applications for development permits and building permits.
Questions for City planning staff can be emailed to
planning@portmoody.ca
.
engage_descriptions.2331-2335-st-johns-ocp-amendment-and-rez:
Thank you to everyone who provided feedback on this development application. The public input period has concluded.
Application #ORD00006
Location: 2331-2335 St. Johns Street
We would like your feedback on an OCP amendment and rezoning application at 2331-2335 St. Johns Street. The applicant would like to build a Mixed Use building up to 6 storeys containing a retail food store and apartments above.
This proposal includes:
One mixed commercial and residential building
6 storeys (retail food store on the first two floors and apartments in the upper storeys)
48 market rental apartments
55,206m2 (56,033.5ft2) including 885m2 (9,525ft2) of commercial space
A gross floor area ratio of 2.63
80 proposed parking spaces(73 Long-Term and 6 Short-Term Bicycle Parking Spaces for residential portion, 1 long term bicycle spaces and 6 short term stalls for commercial portion)
5.5m wide portion of Queens St to be closed and consolidated with the site
Next Steps
On March 11, 2025, Council approved the development permit for issuance
.
The proposal will move forward with the next phase, which includes building permits and servicing agreements.
Questions for City planning staff can be emailed to
planning@portmoody.ca
.
